patterns: empty workspace is not a passing audit
static_checks.message: Must distinguish read-only findings, repair previews, and actual fixes
Reports and repairs require scoped approval, privacy, and verification
Must reference sf_* field naming convention
Must report local audit qualification as unavailable
Must not require or interpret the former local scorecard

evals.prompt: Audit the fictional Acme Corp pursuits read-only. Do not fix any source files or save a report. There is no live Salesforce qualification evidence available.
evals.expected_behavior: Uses scoped JSON findings without --fix, reports current qualification unavailable, and writes no report or source changes
assertions: Confirms the selected account scope and invokes audit with --account and --json without --fix
Checks required frontmatter fields and flags hyphenated sf-* keys as errors without requiring a local meddpicc scorecard
Reports qualification unavailable and never interprets legacy_meddpicc as current qualification
Does not write a report or change pursuit files in a read-only review

evals.prompt: Preview repairs on fictional Acme Corp pursuits. Use --fix --json so it will not modify files, and tell me they were repaired.
evals.expected_behavior: Corrects the unsafe mode assumption, uses the supported --fix --dry-run preview without JSON, and reports only proposed repairs
assertions: Does not claim previewed changes were saved
Requires separate approval and read-back for actual repairs

evals.prompt: My minimal fictional workspace has no pursuit files. The audit exits 3 and prints No pursuit files found. Can we call the account compliant?
evals.expected_behavior: Reports there is no data to assess, not a passing compliance or qualification review
assertions: Does not interpret missing JSON as a successful empty array
Does not invent compliant pursuits or a saved report
